text: The wave-1 box shall play a child's book when its card is placed, keep each card's binding through power cuts and laptop accidents, and log its use.
The Stopwatch harness shall be carried across with fi-5f90c6 fixed.
encode/decode shall round-trip every JSON value, NaN and ±Infinity included, keep null and absent apart, and never read a caller's value as the encoding.
The harness's decision log and replay comparison shall keep NaN and -Infinity, so a NaN logged where null replays is a mismatch.
rationale: fi-5f90c6: two diagnose() mutants survived because the log said null.

text: The card watcher shall hold, leave and crowd as modulo-requirements.json says.
A card on the pad for an hour at 20 polls/s with a quarter of reads missed at random shall never be reported gone.
rationale: SPEC W1. Rate and debounce provisional until the hour of raw polls.

text: A removed playing card shall pause no later than 1.25 s after its last good read; a silent one shall give nothing.
Crowded tags shall pause play at once and do nothing else until a single good read places a card.
A bound card shall play its title from where it stopped this power session, go silent after finishing, and start over when put back.
Bindings shall be made once, kept on the card durably, survive cuts, and be restored from the box's flash when the card loses them.
A new card shall bind to the first free title, or cue and be written to unknown.txt; no binding ever changes, and nothing under /tape/audio is written.
Over months of evenings with books and cards added and cards.json deleted or mangled, no card shall be bound twice nor play another card's title.
A power cut at any step of a bind shall leave the next boot with the old bindings or the old plus exactly that bind, also over months of random cuts.
rationale: SPEC C. Write cards.new, then rename; a stale cards.new is removed at boot.

text: A cards.json (else cards.new) that parses shall decide, {} included; otherwise the flash mirror restores and the restore is logged; a new box restores nothing.
log.txt shall get one line per boot (sd-change when titles differ from this box's last boot), bind, finished title, restore and bad folder.
rationale: SPEC U. Unplug events: a boot line is one.

text: A power cut that tears a log line shall cost only that line: the next boot starts its boot line on a fresh line.
acceptance: T-U-TORN passes: a real cut on the bind log append, then a boot; every line but the torn one parses, and the boot line is whole and last.
rationale: SPEC U leaves robustness of the log to us (line 160). Without the fresh line, the boot line merges into the torn one and the evening is uncounted. Added day 1 turn 4 (Modulo), ta-485e14.

text: The same card, flash and inputs shall give the same events, card and flash, and the box shall be built on des.
rationale: SPEC R; CHOICE: a single des model.

text: Every check shall verify a requirement, and every link shall name a real check.
The printed enclosure shall meet the constraints on tape/hardware and SPEC E.
rationale: council/CHOICE.md takes TAPE-ENC unchanged; SPEC E adds the printer.

text: Each printed part shall build watertight in the exact kernel and fit a 200 mm cube, and one part shall be at least 89 x 64 mm.
acceptance: T-E-PRINT: enclosure/measure.mjs builds every enclosure/*.json with engines/cad (Truck). T-E-GEN: the trees on disk are what gen.mjs makes now.

text: The nest shall hold a 63 x 88 mm card by geometry.
acceptance: I-ENC-NEST: the CAD model's nest pocket clears the card by 0.5 to 1.5 mm per side.
rationale: Children are not careful; geometry is. T-E-NEST reads the pocket walls off the lid model. Revised day 1 turn 3 (Morphyx): 'over the antenna, nothing conductive between' moved to TAPE-ENC-RANGE, because the model has no reader board in it (refs/tape gives no outline) and a check can only verify what the model holds.

text: A card in the nest shall sit over the reader antenna, with nothing conductive between, and read through the printed lid on at least 99% of polls.
acceptance: D-ENC-RANGE: one hour of raw polls logged on the real lid at the chosen thickness and infill; with the reader board mounted where its antenna was measured on the board in hand (calipers, not memory); miss rate at most 1%, and the log is added to the T-CARD-HOLD channels.
rationale: Lid thickness eats read range. Unverified until the household logs the hour; the model carries nestFloor = 2 mm as provisional.

text: The speaker shall be sealed to its baffle with at least 200 cm3 of enclosed air behind it, not shared with the battery bay.
acceptance: A-ENC-SEAL: the CAD model's closed back volume is at least 200 cm3, computed from the model, not estimated.
rationale: A driver open at the back cancels its own bass. Wave 1 has no battery bay.

text: The grille holes shall each be under 4 mm across, with total open area at least 1257 mm2.
acceptance: A-ENC-GRILLE: hole sizes and summed area computed from the CAD model.
rationale: Under 4 mm keeps fingers and crumbs off the cone.
